Project Overview
Overview
White Aluminum Wrap · 12 Openings

Your windows and doors already have new wood trim around them, ready for a finished surface. We'll cover that wood with white aluminum bent to fit each opening. Once it's on, the trim is sealed against weather and never needs painting.

Bend white aluminum on site to fit each opening
Cover the new wood trim on every side of all ten windows
The three windows over the brick get wrapped down to the stone ledge
Wrap the top and both sides of the front and rear entry doors
Fasten, then seal the joints with white caulk to match
Clean up and haul away scrap

What Happens Next
Next Steps
Here's Where We Go From Here

Nothing else is needed from you to price this. Here's how it goes from here.

1
Your written estimate comes separately. Look it over and approve it when you're ready.
2
Your siding crew can keep going. The wrap goes on over the trim that's already up, so we can do it after the new siding is on.
3
Let us know once the siding is finished, or the date you expect it to be, and we'll get you on the schedule.
4
We bend and fit the aluminum on site, seal it, and clean up before we leave.
